description: The jurisdiction index: every state and DC, with the body that decides residency there and the source PathWise verified. It records WHAT IS KNOWN about a jurisdiction, never how far PathWise has modelled it — that is derived from the registered rule packs' own declared capabilities (lib/jurisdiction-coverage.ts), so a claim on the coverage map cannot outrun the engines behind it.

legend.modelled: Rules authored and verified against the primary source. The engines answer in full.
legend.partial: Some rules authored and verified. The pack says which; everything else answers “unable to verify”.
legend.sourced_only: The deciding body and its published rule are captured and linked. PathWise can say who decides and where the rule is — and nothing more.
legend.not_modelled: Nothing captured yet beyond the jurisdiction’s name.
legend.unable_to_verify: A source was sought and could not be confirmed. Deliberately distinct from “not modelled”: one is work not done, the other is work done that failed.

source_url_policy: A jurisdiction's `authority`/`source_url` name the body that decides RESIDENCY there; `aid_authority`/`aid_source_url` name the body that decides STATE AID, which in most states is a different one. Each is present ONLY where that source was opened and read on verified_on. Where one is absent, PathWise says so on screen rather than linking a plausible guess — and a verified residency source never stands in for an unverified aid one, because that would be one check vouching for another nobody made.
